What to find: Methods of distribution (open weights on repositories, API, cloud platforms, apps).
Card sections that often contain it: Model Sources, Availability, Distribution, Access

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Model is distributed via a Hugging Face repository and can be used with the Hugging Face transformers, vLLM or SGLang libraries.
quotes: This repository presents **Falcon-H1R-7B**, a reasoning-specialized model introduced in the paper [Falcon-H1R: Pushing the Reasoning Frontiers with a Hybrid Model for Efficient Test-Time Scaling](https://huggingface.co/papers/2601.02346).
Currently to use this model, you can either rely on Hugging Face `transformers`, `vLLM` or `SGLang` library.
